paper_title: Open Problem: Properly learning decision trees in polynomial time?
authors: Guy Blanc, Jane Lange, Mingda Qiao, Li-Yang Tan
statement: Open Problem 1 Design a poly(n, s, 1/ε)-time membership query algorithm for properly learning size-s decision trees over n variables to error ε under the uniform distribution.
